patterns.note: All major content sections and image blocks are contained within large, full-width modules featuring very pronounced rounded corners, creating a soft, inviting visual structure.

A highly distinctive, expressive display serif font is used for hero headings and the brand's large footer logo, providing a strong brand identity that contrasts with clean, legible sans-serifs for body text and smaller headings.

The site uses a rich, warm, and earthy color palette dominated by deep browns, terracotta oranges, and creamy off-whites, accented by the vibrant red-orange of the product itself and occasional cool-toned background sections.
The top promotional banner disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top, subtly reducing its height and gaining a solid background.

Product showcases and lifestyle content are consistently presented in a grid or stacked layout within distinct, rounded-corner modules, often featuring high-quality photography with a warm, inviting glow.

technique_notes: The header features a top banner that slides out of view on scroll, while the main navigation bar transitions from its initial state to a condensed, sticky version with a solid background as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and image blocks are designed with very large, consistent corner radii, giving a soft, tactile feel to the entire page layout.

Individual content blocks and images appear to animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframe animations triggered by scroll position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Features an oversized, expressive display serif for hero headings (~4x body) and brand identity, complemented by a clean, balanced sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Pill-like rounded corners are applied extensively to almost all content blocks, images, and buttons, creating a very soft and cohesive aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding around content blocks and within sections, contributing to a premium and unhurried feel.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its luxurious, tactile feel, achieved through the consistent use of very large, rounded-corner content blocks and a rich, warm color palette. The unique, expressive display serif font for key headings and the brand logo provides a strong, memorable identity that elevates it beyond typical product sites.
